summary: A mixed day anchored by major Reliance investment plans and retail sector growth projections, alongside judicial appointments and RBI fintech regulation. India's GDP growth at 7.8% and Reliance's Rs 10 lakh crore AI investment commitment are the headline economic drivers.

bullets.text: Reliance and Jio to invest Rs 10 lakh crore over seven years for India's AI transformation, Mukesh Ambani announced.
India GDP growth at 7.8% in latest quarter, economic activity expanded across sectors.
Organised apparel retail revenue to grow 12-13% in FY27, but margins may shrink, Crisil projects.
RBI recognises Unified Fintech Forum as second self-regulatory body for fintech sector.
Supreme Court Collegium recommends 3 judicial officers for elevation to Jharkhand High Court.
